items.title: Johnny Varro interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001
items.q: One was run by Bob Maltz and the other was run by Jack Crystal...

ctx.x: I read somewhere that you had sat in or played for Willie “The Lion” Smith? Is that right?

Willie became one of my first mentors at the Central Plaza. Now I’m going back a couple of years to when I was about nineteen or twenty. The sessions were run in lower New York, New York City on the lower East Side. It was the Stuyvesant Casino and the Central Plaza. There are two big halls. And on Friday and Saturday night each hall would have their own jam session. One was run by Bob Maltz and the other was run by Jack Crystal, who is Billy Crystal’s dad. That’s why Billy’s got such a great influence in the…
Didn’t his father sell records or something too?
